children: rose 3.78% intraday after chairman and CEO Ryan Cohen disclosed buying 1,000,000 shares at a weighted average of $20.3759, in open market transactions ranging from $20.0199 to $20.4699. That cost roughly $20 million.

The filing puts his beneficial ownership at 43,082,626 shares, or about 8.5%, against 504,500,990 shares outstanding as of September 3. That total includes 3,734,784 shares underlying warrants Cohen received for no consideration under a warrant dividend distribution to stockholders. The directly owned position is 39,347,842 shares, worth roughly $833 million at today's price of $21.16.

title: GameStop Stock Rises 4% After Cohen Discloses a Million-Share Buy
